[[File:Zombie hand icon.png|left]]
'''Zombie hands''' only appear in the [[Meiyerditch tunnels]]. They can be killed instead of [[crawling Hand]]s or [[zombie]]s for [[Slayer assignments]], to gain more experience and better drops. Meiyerditch tunnels can only be accessed during and after the [[Legacy of Seergaze]] quest. [[Skeletal hand]]s, which are in the same area as zombie hands, will occasionally drop from the ceiling or come up from the ground and attack players.

Zombie hands have very low defence, so players wearing a [[salve amulet]] or [[salve amulet (e)]] can kill them faster than [[Experiment]]s in [[Experiment Cave]]. 

A [[cannon]] used in tandem with [[Chinchompa (item)|Chinchompas]] or [[burst spells]] can make short work of a slayer assignment. However, this is an expensive approach, and the drops barely make up for the cost of prayer potions, runes, and/or ammunition consumed.

Players should use a [[Mask of Broken Fingers]] (or its helm variant [[Helm of the Dead Hand]]) to kill these, especially when on a slayer assignment, to take advantage of its benefits.

Players can obtain a soul of a crawling hand for the [[Slayer Codex]] from this creature when using an [[ushabti]].

===Getting there===
* For players who have completed [[The Branches of Darkmeyer]], [[Drakan's medallion]] can teleport them to the Meiyerditch labs which connects to the dungeon.
* Using the [[blood altar teleport]] to the [[blood altar]].
* Travelling to the [[Abyss]], then to the [[blood rift]] and exiting the altar is a quick way to them. To avoid prayer drain, wear a [[forinthry bracelet]] or use [[prayer potions]].
* Players with level 65 Agility (this can be boosted) can use an [[Agility#Shortcuts|Agility shortcut]] behind [[Ivandis Seergaze]]'s tomb.
* Using blood altar [[Runecrafting Teleport Tablets]] is faster than using the Abyss and does not drain prayer, and can be obtained as a reward from the [[Great Orb Project]] activity.
* The [[Mask of Broken Fingers]] or its [[Helm of the Dead Hand|upgraded version]] can teleport players directly to the dungeon twice per day.
